title.en: Energy meteorology: a reading path from data to decisions
title.zh: 能源气象入门：从数据、预测到业务决策

summary.en: A focused reading map for power forecasting, multi-source fusion and forecast correction, with a concrete question for each paper.
summary.zh: 围绕功率预测、多源融合和预报订正整理阅读路径，每篇论文都带着一个具体问题去读。

basis.en: Curated from public research descriptions, Crossref title/DOI records and official learning resources, checked on 5 November 2026. Paper methods and experimental results still require full-text reading.
basis.zh: 依据公开研究方向、Crossref 题名与 DOI 记录、官方学习资源，于 2026-11-05 整理。论文的具体方法与实验结论仍需阅读全文核对。

paragraphs.en: Energy meteorology connects weather information to decisions about power generation and operations. For a first learning task, narrow the scope to a specified site, target and forecast horizon. A point forecast of power, a warning of a rapid change and a maintenance decision require different evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 能源气象把天气信息转成发电与运行决策。入门时先限定一个站点、一项指标和一个预测跨度：预测功率、提醒功率突变、安排巡检，需要的证据并不相同。

paragraphs.en: My engineering experience provides a starting point in input validation, asynchronous interfaces and traceable delivery. The new work is to learn the physical meaning of variables, data availability and forecast evaluation before building a larger system.
paragraphs.zh: 已有工程经验可以从输入校验、异步交互和可追溯交付切入；接下来要补的是变量的物理含义、数据可获得时间和预测评估方法。先把这些弄清楚，再扩展系统。

title.en: 02 / Foundations: read before adding a model
title.zh: 02 / 基础层：先看数据，再看模型

paragraphs.en: Read the time-series cross-validation chapter in FPP3 and the ERA5 dataset description. Write down observation time, release time, timezone, units and the distinction between reanalysis and operational forecast products.
paragraphs.zh: 先读 FPP3 的时间序列交叉验证章节与 ERA5 数据说明，列出观测时间、发布时间、时区、单位，以及再分析数据和业务预报产品的区别。

paragraphs.en: ERA5 is useful for retrospective analysis. Downloading it today does not establish that its final values were available at a historical forecast issue time. A retrospective learning exercise and an operational backtest should be labeled separately.
paragraphs.zh: ERA5 适合回溯分析，但今天下载到的最终数值，不代表历史预报发出时就能获得。回溯学习实验和业务预报回测，应分别说明。

title.zh: 03 / 应用层：三篇论文，三个阅读问题

bullets.en: Solar Energy (2024), DOI 10.1016/j.solener.2024.112706: which sources are fused for photovoltaic power prediction, and does each source arrive before the forecast is issued? Record the answer after reading the full text.
bullets.zh: Solar Energy（2024），DOI 10.1016/j.solener.2024.112706：光伏预测融合了哪些来源？每个来源是否在预报发出前可得？阅读全文后再填写答案。

bullets.en: Energy (2024), DOI 10.1016/j.energy.2024.130402: what are the two branches in the wind-power model, and what do single-branch comparisons establish? Check the comparison protocol, not just the best score.
bullets.zh: Energy（2024），DOI 10.1016/j.energy.2024.130402：风电模型的两个分支分别处理什么？单分支对比说明了什么？重点核对比较条件。

bullets.en: IEEE GRSL (2023), DOI 10.1109/LGRS.2023.3307717: what is being corrected in the ECMWF forecast products, and how is improvement measured against the uncorrected forecast?
bullets.zh: IEEE GRSL（2023），DOI 10.1109/LGRS.2023.3307717：订正的是 ECMWF 产品中的什么变量？相对原始预报，改进按什么口径计算？

title.zh: 04 / 方法层：迁移之前，先保留基线

paragraphs.en: The existing TFT input-availability note is a bridge to multi-horizon forecasting. Treat TFT, feature-level fusion and output correction as choices to compare under the same inputs and evaluation windows. This reading map does not establish that a larger model is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 已有 TFT 输入边界笔记可以衔接多步预测。TFT、特征层融合和输出订正，应放在相同输入、相同评估窗口下比较。仅凭这份阅读目录，不能断言需要更大的模型。

paragraphs.en: For later reading, keep optimization and AI agents as a separate branch: first identify the action, cost, constraints and validation environment. Forecast quality and policy quality are different questions.
paragraphs.zh: 多目标优化和 AI 智能体可作为后续分支：先写清动作、代价、约束与验证环境。预测质量与决策策略质量，是两个问题。

title.zh: 05 / 下一步：先交付一个能复查的小实验

bullets.en: Planned: make a data dictionary with source licenses, units, timestamps and missing-value rules.
bullets.zh: 计划：整理含许可、单位、时间戳和缺失规则的数据字典。

bullets.en: Planned: compare persistence and same-time-previous-day baselines on chronological windows; retain errors by horizon and the sample count.
bullets.zh: 计划：按时间窗口比较持续性与前一天同一时刻基线，保留分跨度误差和样本数。

bullets.en: Planned: show one successful result and one delayed-input case in a small dashboard. No new dataset or model reproduction is claimed in this note.
bullets.zh: 计划：用小看板展示一个正常结果和一个输入延迟场景。本篇尚未提供新数据集实验或论文复现结果。
